scope: Exact DS1 signature for every n≥1; actual homogeneous polynomial subspaces and partial derivatives, independent binomial norms, quaternion A-jB convention and right complex scalars, exact inverse, n=1 endpoint, and degree-two middle-monomial norm. No independent human review is claimed.
output:
MathResearch.Spinor.DS1_v1 (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
  ∃ (e : ↥(BinaryForm n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(CompatibleRow (n - 1))),
    (∀ (p : ↥(BinaryForm n)) (i : Fin 2), ↑((↑(e p)).ofLp i) = (↑n)⁻¹ • (pderiv i) ↑p) ∧
      (∀ (h : ↥(CompatibleRow (n - 1))), ↑(e.symm h) = X 0 * ↑((↑h).ofLp 0) + X 1 * ↑((↑h).ofLp 1)) ∧
        Module.finrank ℂ ↥(CompatibleRow (n - 1)) = n + 1
MathResearch.Spinor.spinorIsometry (m : ℕ) : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1)) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(CompatibleRow m)
MathResearch.Spinor.binaryForm_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm n)) :
  ‖p‖ ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), ‖(coefficients n) p k‖ ^ 2 / ↑(n.choose ↑k)
MathResearch.Spinor.formRow_norm_sq (m : ℕ) (h : FormRow m) :
  ‖h‖ ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), ‖quaternionCoefficients m h k‖ ^ 2 / ↑(m.choose ↑k)
MathResearch.Spinor.quaternionCoefficients_bijective (m : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (quaternionCoefficients m)
MathResearch.Spinor.pack_smul (z a b : ℂ) : pack (z * a) (z * b) = pack a b * ↑z
MathResearch.Spinor.normalizedGradient_quaternionCoefficients (m : ℕ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) (k : Fin (m + 1)) :
  quaternionCoefficients m (↑((normalizedGradient m) p)) k =
    pack ((coefficients m) ((derivative m 0) p) k) ((coefficients m) ((derivative m 1) p) k) * (↑(↑m + 1))⁻¹
MathResearch.Spinor.derivative_norm_sq (m : ℕ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))) :
  ‖(derivative m 0) p‖ ^ 2 + ‖(derivative m 1) p‖ ^ 2 = (↑m + 1) ^ 2 * ‖p‖ ^ 2
MathResearch.Spinor.finrank_compatibleRow (m : ℕ) : Module.finrank ℂ ↥(CompatibleRow m) = m + 2
'MathResearch.Spinor.DS1_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
